```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))

indicators <- read.csv(
  file.path(root, "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/processed/municipal-indicators-tarragones-2021.csv"),
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

## Descomposa el parc comarcal en principals i no principals a partir dels totals municipals.
principal <- sum(indicators$housing_total) - sum(indicators$housing_non_main)
no_principal <- sum(indicators$housing_non_main)
total <- principal + no_principal

## Geometria de l'anell: cada part es converteix en un tros d'anell entre dos angles.
## Treballarem en radi i angle amb coord_polar(theta = "y").
parts <- data.frame(
  nom = c("Habitatges principals", "Habitatges no principals"),
  valor = c(principal, no_principal),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
parts$frac <- parts$valor / total
parts$ymax <- cumsum(parts$frac)
parts$ymin <- c(0, head(parts$ymax, -1))
parts$pct <- paste0(format(round(parts$frac * 100, 1), decimal.mark = ","), "%")

## Marquem el forat central: en coord_polar theta="y", l'eix x és el radi.
## Amb xmin/xmax limitem el gruix de l'anell i xlim obre el forat.
ring <- 1.8
parts$xmin <- 0.55 * ring
parts$xmax <- ring

parts$xmid <- (parts$xmin + parts$xmax) / 2
parts$ymid <- (parts$ymin + parts$ymax) / 2

fig <- ggplot(parts, aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax)) +
  geom_rect(aes(fill = nom), color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = xmid, y = ymid, label = pct),
    size = 3.4,
    color = "#17202a",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Habitatges principals" = "#2171b5",
      "Habitatges no principals" = "#9ecae1"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, ring + 0.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Habitatges principals i no principals del Tarragonès (2021)",
    caption = paste0("Total comarcal: ", format(total, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ","),
                     " habitatges. Font: Idescat, habitatges per tipus d'habitatge, 2021.")
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0.5, color = "#17202a"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "#52616b", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 8)),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(color = "#52616b")
  )

output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/data-visualization/housing-donut-tarragones-2021.svg")
dir.create(dirname(output), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(output, fig, width = 8, height = 6, device = svglite::svglite)
```
